reviewed_against: 3GPP TS 23.401 §5.3.2 initial attach and default bearer establishment
3GPP TS 29.281 §4.4 GTP-U TEID and receiving endpoint

generation_closure_paths.requires: the accepted release names the released S1-U receiving endpoint

requires: an accepted EPC session-identity analysis whose release binding, session-to-generation link and closure candidate are all ESTABLISHED for this capture
the lifecycle's own boundary record independently classifies the same release transaction as accepted in the same capture
exactly one candidate release; an ambiguous direct path never falls back
request and confirmation frames stay distinct and release_effective_frame_proven stays false

correlation_strength_policy.STRONG: eligible when every other gate passes
correlation_strength_policy.SUPPORTED: eligible when every other gate passes; published so the weaker corroboration stays visible
correlation_strength_policy.NONE: never sufficient for an advertisement family or a release outcome

not_confirmed: an advertisement family is a group of protocol advertisements, not an EPS bearer
a matched request and response prove correlation, not successful user-plane provisioning
an accepted Cause is a control-plane outcome; it does not confirm UE delivery or application reachability
a generation reference is a scoped pseudonymous label, never a subscriber identity
a numerically reused TEID is not treated as a new generation without a proved boundary
an unresolved generation attribution is not packet loss and not a tunnel failure
no S11 to S5/S8 session identity is asserted
no complete EPC bearer state machine is implemented
a release that merely repeats an endpoint value never closes a generation
the exact instant user-plane forwarding stopped is not proven by an accepted release response
